title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Appointment of Teachers, etc.)
(1) Each national technical high school shall have a principal.
(2) Pursuant to Article 33 (2) of the Educational Officials Act, the principal of a national technical high school shall be appointed by the President upon recommendation of the Minister of SMEs and Startups. [Amended on July 26, 2017.]
(3) The authority to appoint principals under paragraph (2), excluding the authority to appoint a person as principal, shall be delegated to the Minister of SMEs and Startups pursuant to Article 33 (2) of the Educational Officials Act. [Amended on July 26, 2017.]
(4) Pursuant to Article 33 (2) of the Educational Officials Act, vice principals, master teachers, and teachers of national technical high schools shall be appointed by the Minister of SMEs and Startups. [Amended on July 26, 2017.]
(5) Of the appointing authority under paragraph (4), the Minister of SMEs and Startups shall delegate the following authority to the principals of national technical high schools pursuant to Article 33 (2) of the Educational Officials Act: [Amended on July 26, 2017.]
1. Appointment of teachers under their jurisdiction;
2. Promotion in salary step of vice principals under their jurisdiction.
